classification.difficultyReason: Combine consecutive survey lengths before pairing corresponding sides of nested similar triangles.

content.prompt: Determine the width of the river.

spec.description: An unfilled river outline beside two nested right triangles. Their left sides share a vertical survey line, and their hypotenuses lie on one straight diagonal through the bottom point, the endpoint of the 7 m segment and the rock.
spec.mathematics: Consecutive vertical segments are 12 m above and 15 m below the intermediate point. The smaller horizontal side is 7 m. The upper horizontal side is w. Both horizontal sides are perpendicular to the survey line.
spec.answerVisibility: The labels 12 m, 15 m, 7 m, w, Rock and River remain visible. No calculated length appears.
